title: Pets Codex - Codex Desktop Pets Gallery and Installer
description: Browse community-made Codex desktop pets, preview animated spritesheets, copy npx install commands, or download pet packages for macOS and Windows.
text: 1 Copy a command Run npx petscodex install byte . The installer resolves the package by slug and places the pet files for you.
